criteria.text: Given the invocation names extra keys, When align starts, Then those keys are extracted in order without duplicates
Given the ticket body references another key, When align starts, Then that key is extracted too
Given the text contains AC-1, UTF-8, RFC-2606 or SHA-256, When keys are extracted, Then none is treated as an issue key
Given the target key itself appears, When keys are extracted, Then it is excluded
Given the repo project key is known, When keys are extracted, Then only keys for that project are returned
Given many references, When keys are extracted, Then the list is capped
